selected_evidence.requirement: Run os-comparison-worker as the managed inventory-worker service
selected_evidence.summary: The validated unit uses ExecStart=/usr/local/bin/os-comparison-worker and was enabled, active, and running under its systemd cgroup.
The unit was enabled before reboot and returned active automatically in the subsequent boot, with zero restarts.

selected_evidence.summary: Captured the healthy baseline, acknowledged a delayed native reboot, proved the boot ID changed from 5924df3e-0d8c-4196-80ba-87baffa76cc8 to cfbe3c02-b8fa-41a4-9649-6aea63217872, and verified full service/process recovery.

commands.command:
set -eu
unit_tmp=$(mktemp /tmp/inventory-worker.service.XXXXXX)
trap 'rm -f "$unit_tmp"' EXIT HUP INT TERM
cat > "$unit_tmp" <<'ANTRIEB_UNIT'
[Unit]
Description=Inventory worker

[Service]
Type=simple
ExecStart=/usr/local/bin/os-comparison-worker
Restart=on-failure

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
ANTRIEB_UNIT
install -o root -g root -m 0644 "$unit_tmp" /etc/systemd/system/inventory-worker.service
systemd-analyze verify /etc/systemd/system/inventory-worker.service
printf '%s\n' 'installed=/etc/systemd/system/inventory-worker.service'

set -eu
systemctl daemon-reload
systemctl enable --now inventory-worker.service
printf 'enabled='; systemctl is-enabled inventory-worker.service
printf 'active='; systemctl is-active inventory-worker.service

set -eu
printf 'boot_id='; cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id
printf 'enabled='; systemctl is-enabled inventory-worker.service
printf 'active='; systemctl is-active inventory-worker.service
systemctl is-active --quiet inventory-worker.service
main_pid=$(systemctl show inventory-worker.service -p MainPID --value)
test "$main_pid" -gt 0
kill -0 "$main_pid"
printf 'main_pid=%s\n' "$main_pid"
printf 'main_exe='; readlink "/proc/$main_pid/exe"
printf 'main_cmdline='; tr '\000' ' ' < "/proc/$main_pid/cmdline"; printf '\n'
systemctl show inventory-worker.service -p LoadState -p ActiveState -p SubState -p UnitFileState -p NRestarts --no-pager
printf '%s\n' 'unit_definition:'
systemctl cat inventory-worker.service --no-pager
